name: tibial stretch with semi flexed knee
description: A bent-knee stretch that targets the lower calf and the muscles around the shin.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and the toes pressed against the wall or floor.
Bend the knee of the stretching leg slightly.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch low in the calf.
Keep the heel on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
